decisions.statement: A reset is always confirmed whether the seat runs or not.
A stopped seat is asked nothing.
A running seat is asked only where a step stops or restarts its process.
The prompt names the seat and names the act in the act's own word.
A reset says the agent is lost rather than the turn.
Nothing here asks anything of Alan.

definition: what Alan is asked before an act loses the turn a seat is part-way through
